blocks.text: Shintenchi 4 Piece Patio Furniture Set, Outdoor Rattan Conversation Set with Coffee Table, Outside Wicker Sectional Sofa Couch with Cushion, Gray and Blue

items.label: Various Combination
items.value: This versatile set includes two armchairs, a loveseat, and a coffee table—all designed for easy mobility. Customize the layout to match your space, maximizing both style and functionality

items.label: Built to Last
items.value: Constructed with a robust steel frame and handwoven rattan, this 4-piece set resists wear from sun, rain, and wind. After inclement weather, a quick wipe-down restores it to ready-to-use condition

items.label: Hassle-Free Maintenance
items.value: The included coffee table features a secure, suction-mounted tempered glass top, perfect for holding drinks without tipping. Cleanup is effortless—simply wipe the glass surface. Spills? A damp cloth is all you need

items.label: Ergonomic Design
items.value: Designed for relaxation, the thick cushioned seats and contoured backrests provide exceptional support. Whether hosting guests or unwinding solo, this set ensures hours of comfortable seating

items.label: Comfortable Seating
items.value: Experience exceptional relaxation with our high-back sofa, featuring deep seats and wide armrests for a perfect blend of modern style and cozy comfort. The high-density foam cushions provide superior lumbar support
